purpose: Semantic, context-aware WesBot routing. Dataset teaches meaning; live WESCOMM data provides facts.

low.behavior: safe fallback; do not guess; offer staff assistance when appropriate

grounding_rules: Never answer stock or price from the dataset; query live catalog/inventory.
Never answer reservation, payment, receipt, or pickup status from the dataset; query the authenticated student's live records.
Policy answers must come from published/verified FAQs or authoritative policy records.
Use the last 4-6 relevant conversation messages for follow-up questions.
A semantic match is valid even when the student's exact sentence never appears in the dataset.
If multiple records could match a pronoun or vague reference, clarify instead of guessing.
